items.source: Invokes buildFeedItems(Map, HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse) to get a list of feed items.
items.translation: 调用buildFeedItems(Map, HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse)获取提要项目列表。

items.source: Application-specific view classes will extend this class. The view will be held in the subclass itself, not in a template. Main entry points are the AbstractFeedView.buildFeedMetadata(Map, T, HttpServletRequest) and buildFeedItems(Map, HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse).
items.translation: 特定于应用程序的视图类将扩展此类。视图将保存在子类本身中，而不是模板中。主要入口点是 AbstractFeedView.buildFeedMetadata(Map, T, HttpServletRequest) 和 buildFeedItems(Map, HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse)。

items.source: By default returns an RSS 2.0 channel, but the subclass can specify any channel.
items.translation: 默认返回一个 RSS 2.0 频道，但子类可以指定任何频道。

items.translation: request - 如果需要区域设置等信息。不应查看属性。

items.translation: response - 如果我们需要设置 Cookie，则不应向其写入。

items.translation: 要添加到 Feed 的 Feed 项目

items.source: Thanks to Jettro Coenradie and Sergio Bossa for the original feed view prototype!
items.translation: 感谢 Jettro Coenradie 和 Sergio Bossa 提供的原始 Feed 视图原型！

items.source:
Note that the passed-in HTTP response is just supposed to be used for
setting cookies or other HTTP headers. The built feed itself will automatically
get written to the response after this method returns.
items.translation: 注意，传入的 HTTP 响应仅用于设置 Cookie 或其他 HTTP 标头。内置的 Feed 将在本方法返回后自动写入响应中。

items.source: since 7.0. Libraries or applications can provide their own View class or perform rendering in web handlers directly.
items.translation: 自 7.0 版本起，库或应用程序可以提供自己的 `View` 类，或在 Web 处理器中直接执行渲染。

items.source: Subclasses must implement this method to build feed items, given the model.
items.translation: 子类必须实现此方法，以便根据模型构建 Feed 项目。

items.translation: 创建一个新的 Channel 实例来存储条目。
